writeup: Woot has the Sharpie Creative Markers Earth Tones 12-pack (water-based acrylic, bullet tip) for $9.99, new. Walmart sells the same set for $19.97 and Office Depot for $19.99, so this is about half price. The paint-like ink won't bleed through paper and marks on wood, rock, glass, metal and canvas.
